summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K to extend the redemption request deadline for its proposed business combination with GOWell Technology Limited. The deadline was moved from 5:00 p.m. ET on September 1, 2026 to 5:00 p.m. ET on September 2, 2026, with withdrawal requests accepted until the new deadline. The registration statement was declared effective on August 11, 2026, and the definitive proxy statement/prospectus was mailed to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine procedural extension in advance of the shareholder vote on the business combination, not a substantive strategic change. What to watch: the outcome of the redemption requests and shareholder approval of the deal.
